messages.content: Hi tal, I'm a friend

hey, i'm tal

think of me as your personal talent agent, your inside man… or fox

one of these days, I might slide a role right here in chat. the kind that feels like your calling.

so… what's your full name?
Mohammad Mobasshir
mohammad mobasshir... solid name. where you working these days?
Accenture Strategy & Consulting

accenture strategy & consulting... that's the "we charge 10x what freelancers do and call it transformation" game. found mohammad mobasshir on linkedin - strategy, product, program guy. this you? https://in.linkedin.com/in/mmobasshir
Yes

strategy & consulting at accenture... you're in the "let's digitally transform your grandfather's business" space. bet you've written more powerpoints than code. what made you get into consulting? was it the travel or just couldn't decide between product and strategy so you picked both?
Probably the latter. Needed a change after 5 years and a salary hike and found a quick place to scout opportunities for the next move

ah the classic "consulting as a layover" strategy. smart move actually - get the brand name, the salary bump, then use their client network to figure out what you actually want to build. how long you been working total?
5.5 years
5.5 years... that sweet spot where you're too experienced for junior roles but not quite senior enough to coast. what kind of role you looking for next?
I want to get into something meaty. More ownership. More control. More possibility of calling the shots. Preferably strategy or product or both.

roles will start flowing based on what you actually want - meaty stuff with real ownership, not more deck building. middle east market is interesting... lots of opportunity there if you're serious about it.
